description: Puts small text labels on modules and cables in the patch, keeping each label attached to what it names as that is moved.

params.text: Locks the labels so they cannot be moved or edited; unlocked, a label can be dragged within its module and edited from its own context menu.
Arms labelling: press it, then click a module to put a new label on it.
Raises the opacity of every label by 5%.
Lowers the opacity of every label by 5%.
Hides every label while it is switched on.

notes: a label can be dragged half its module's width past the module's edge, and is drawn above the module but below the cables.
no label appears until the LABEL button is pressed and a module is then clicked; Ctrl and G places one at the pointer while unlocked, and Ctrl and X removes the one under it.
menu: Label appearance — what every new label is given: Default size 8 to 24 pixels, Default width 20 to 180 pixels, Default opacity, Default rotation of 0, 90 or 270 degrees, and Default font.
Consolidate GLUE — moves the labels of every other GLUE in the patch into this one and removes those modules.
Skew labels — gives each new label a small random tilt; switched off, new labels are placed square.
Module Labels and Cable Labels — list every label this module holds, each with Delete.
Appearance, Duplicate and Delete — on a label's own right-click menu, reached while the labels are unlocked; Appearance holds Size, Width, Opacity, Rotation, Color, Font and font colour.
GLUE Cable Label — on a port's own right-click menu, adding a label to a cable on that port at either end.
